method: programmatic drawing: heightfield masonry (rounded, chipped blocks; coursed, voussoir and drum face patterns) splatted into a z-buffer with grounded and floating passes, ray-cast ellipsoids for bark and foliage tufts, screen-space flat decals, and a running-bond slab surface
rendererOrigin: Canvas, ellipsoid, rod, tuft, base_grass and the rock tone rules are adapted copies of scripts/build-camp-panorama-assets.py (copied, not imported, so camp edits never change these bytes)

inputRoles.campAtlas: palette samples; camp props in the mock courtyard and style match
inputRoles.worldAtlas: registration and timing reference for monastery-world.png (no pixels copied); v2 frames in the comparison preview; magenta sample
inputRoles.worldManifest: brazier, shrine and hound clips (layout the world atlas reproduces)
inputRoles.conceptRoad: palette samples and courtyard arrangement reference (Paper p-4-0 artboard 03), no pixels copied
inputRoles.conceptKit: flagstone, wall corner, arch and drum reference (Paper p-4-0 artboard 06), no pixels copied
inputRoles.keyart: courtyard stone reference (art bible 07), no pixels copied
inputRoles.courtyardV1: the current courtyard wall, arch and column art, recorded as the replaced reference

seeds: fixed integer salts in the script; random.Random only
